headline: Magical Wonder Night
title: Magical Wonder Night | New Home season | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Aniimo's new Home season, Magical Wonder Night, is live until December ninth. You need R V level ten and the Festivals of Astra tutorial quest. It brings the Wonder Night Set, the Batshadow Pumpkin R V skin and a new Magic Pumpkin crop. Your Harvest Moon currencies convert to Home Coins, and the Harvest Moon Set leaves the shop. Have you started yet? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Home season Magical Wonder Night runs until 9 December 2026: RV level 10, Wonder Night Set, Batshadow Pumpkin RV skin, Magic Pumpkin crop; Harvest Moon currencies convert to Home Coins.
